scope: Waller 2022 Table of Distribution designations lacking a publication link on 2026-09-27; 7 linked (not already in the ledger), 0 held for missing or ambiguous publication source records.

entries.basis: Waller 2022's Table of Distribution lists this bowl as 'IM 76752 = Faraj 2021', naming the publication that edits it. This records the publication link only; it does not adopt Waller's or the edition's reading. Resolved 2026-09-27: the edition's own title names IM 76752 (author's CV).

Waller 2022's Table of Distribution lists this bowl as 'IM 141803 = Faraj 2010', naming the publication that edits it. This records the publication link only; it does not adopt Waller's or the edition's reading. Resolved 2026-09-27: Waller's short title 'Faraj 2010' is taken as the Udine proceedings article because the author-deposited text identifies its first bowl as IM 141803. Faraj's 2010 Coppe magiche monograph has not been checked and may also include it.
